repairs.text: Strongest feature: Shermer interrogates the cosmological argument’s decisive inferential transition, pressing for justification of why explanation must be a personal entity instead of an impersonal condition or universe-generating reality. Principal limitation: The regress criticism does not fully engage Lennox’s conception of an uncreated source, because it treats the proposed terminus too much like another contingent universe-causing member, while Shermer’s alternative nonentity remains unspecified and unsupported. Live burden: Shermer must explain what a nonentity could intelligibly be, show that it can possess explanatory resources, and establish why this possibility undercuts rather than competes with the inference to an intelligent terminus. Locked score: A locked score of 70 recognizes a challenge to an insufficiently defended entity inference, while discounting its speculative alternative and engagement with the uncreated-source reply.
Shermer invokes controlled intercessory-prayer studies finding no faster recovery for prayed-for patients, concluding that measurable claims of interventionist divine healing lack empirical support.
